items.question: Are GCC nationals counted towards the Emiratisation quota for UAE citizens in the UAE private sector?
items.gold: No, GCC nationals are not counted towards the Emiratisation quota.
items.fact: GCC nationals are not counted towards Emiratisation quota

items.question: Which government ministry issues work permits for GCC nationals hired by establishments in the UAE?
items.gold: The Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation issues the work permits.
items.fact: Work permits for GCC nationals come from Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation
